title: Departments & Roles
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Ahora conoces la estructura de la empresa y los departamentos principales en inglés.

stages.title: Departamentos y Roles en la Empresa

parts.visual: Departamentos: HR (Human Resources - Recursos Humanos). IT (Information Technology - Tecnología). R&D (Research and Development - Investigación y Desarrollo). PR (Public Relations). Sales (Ventas). Marketing. Accounting (Contabilidad).
parts.audio: Departments. HR stands for Human Resources. IT stands for Information Technology. R&D stands for Research and Development. PR stands for Public Relations. Sales, Marketing, and Accounting.

parts.visual: Roles: CEO (Chief Executive Officer). CFO (Chief Financial Officer). Manager (Gerente). Employee (Empleado). Assistant (Asistente). Supervisor (Supervisor).
parts.audio: Roles in the company. CEO is the Chief Executive Officer. CFO is the Chief Financial Officer. Manager. Employee. Assistant. Supervisor.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el departamento o rol correcto según la descripción.

questions.question: This department hires new employees. It's ____. (Recursos Humanos).
My computer is broken. I need to call ____. (Tecnología de la información).
This department pays the bills and manages the money. It's ____. (Contabilidad).
They invent new products. It's the ____ department. (Investigación y Desarrollo).
questions.explanation: R&D (Research and Development) = Investigación y Desarrollo.

questions.question: They sell the products to clients. It's the ____ department. (Ventas).
This department manages advertising and social media. It's ____. (Mercadotecnia).
They handle the image of the company with the press. It's ____. (Relaciones Públicas).
This department deals with legal contracts. It's the ____ department. (Legal/Jurídico).
The highest position in the company is the ____. (Director Ejecutivo).
questions.explanation: CEO (Chief Executive Officer) = Director Ejecutivo / Presidente.

questions.question: The person who manages the money and finances of the company is the ____. (Director Financiero).
He is the ____ of the marketing department. He leads the team. (Gerente/Director).
questions.explanation: Manager = Gerente o Director de área.

questions.question: I am the administrative ____. I help the manager. (Asistente).
We have 500 ____ in our company. (Empleados).
The company that hires you is your ____. (Empleador/Patrón).
questions.explanation: Employer = Empleador (la empresa que te da trabajo).

questions.question: The ____ check the quality of the work on the factory floor. (Supervisores).
The board of ____ makes the big decisions. (Directores).
questions.explanation: Board of directors = Junta directiva / Consejo de administración.

questions.question: This department helps customers with their problems. It's ____ Service. (Servicio al cliente).
A senior manager in a company is called an ____. (Ejecutivo).
She is the ____ of the company. She started the business. (Fundadora).
This department buys materials for the company. It's ____. (Compras).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe las siglas del departamento o el rol de la persona.

questions.question: Human Resources is ____. (Siglas)
Information Technology is ____. (Siglas)
Research and Development is ____. (Siglas con el signo &)
Public Relations is ____. (Siglas)
The Chief Executive Officer is the ____. (Siglas)
The Chief Financial Officer is the ____. (Siglas)
She is the Marketing ____. (Gerente)
I am the administrative ____. (Asistente)
We have 100 ____. (Empleados)
They work in ____ Service. (Servicio al cliente - Customer)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta sobre departamentos.
